notes.title: Update v1.75
notes.content:
Update version 1.75

Fixes:
 -Fixed the Healers AI problem of constantly healing.

Changes:
 -further adjusted equipment stats.
 -Claire now only attacks flying units.

tags.bug: -Fixed the Healers AI problem of constantly healing.

notes.title: Update v1.7
notes.content:
Update version 1.7

changes:
 1. Added Replay button to quickly replay current stage.
 2. Archers can only attack flying units now. 
 3. Equipment stats have been changed to reflect unit roles.
 4. Chapter 4 is now available

Currently known bugs:
 1. Healer will continue healing full HP units, instead of returning to location.
 2. During the last wave if player manages to kill all on screen enemies before enemies are finished spawning, the result screen will show up.

Oversight:
 -Claire (Archer main) will only attack ground enemies, but not flying enemies. This will change in the next update.

tags.feature: 1. Added Replay button to quickly replay current stage.

tags.balance_change: 2. Archers can only attack flying units now.
3. Equipment stats have been changed to reflect unit roles.

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
Update v1.6

fixed Healer AI
 noticed that the healers didn't move when clicked on. They should now be able to move.

fixed cursor bug
 sometimes cursor can be seen outside of battle. This shouldn't happen now.
